{{Quote|What are they?|The Balnab referring to C-3PO and R2-D2|<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>}}
A '''Balnab''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
This [[Balnab (group)/Legends|Balnab]] lived on the planet Balnab when [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] landed on it during the [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Battle of Patitite Pattuna]]. This Balnab and two others rode [[Tee-muss/Legends|Tee-muss]] and were out hinting for [[Hesten/Legends|Hesten]] when they ran into the two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and captured them. The Balnabs did not know what the two were so they decided to take them to their leader, [[Albee Dewaw/Legends|Albee Dewaw]].

After C-3PO and R2-D2 revealed the true identity of Albee Dewaw, this Balnab and the rest of the villagers destroyed the [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]] and freed themselves from being slaves.
